title: Sections over the complement of V(I) in Spec A and maps from powers of I
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ a finitely generated ideal and $M$ an $A$-module. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $D=X\setminus V(I)=\{\mathfrak p\in X: I\not\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$, an open subset with $D=\bigcup_{f\in I}D(f)$. Let $\widetilde M$ be the $\mathcal O_X$-module of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], with $\tau_W:M\to\widetilde M(W)$, and for $f\in A$ identify $\widetilde M(D(f))$ with the localization $M_f$ as there ($x/f^k\leftrightarrow f^{-k}\tau_{D(f)}(x)$). Let $I^0=A$ and $I^n$ ($n\ge1$) the $n$-th power of $I$, and $M_n=\{x\in M: ax=0\text{ for all }a\in I^n\}$ (so $M_0=0$); then $I^{n+1}\subseteq I^n$ and $M_n\subseteq M_{n+1}$. (1) For every $n\ge0$ and every $A$-linear $\varphi:I^n\to M$ there is a unique $c_n(\varphi)\in\widetilde M(D)$ with $c_n(\varphi)|_{D(f)}=\varphi(f^n)/f^n\in M_f$ for every $f\in I$; one has $c_{n+1}(\varphi|_{I^{n+1}})=c_n(\varphi)$, and the induced map $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_A(I^n,M)\to\widetilde M(D)$ (colimit over $n\ge0$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] with transition maps the restrictions along $I^{n+1}\subseteq I^n$) is injective. (2) For every $n\ge0$ and every $A$-linear $\psi:I^n\to M/M_n$ there is a unique $c'_n(\psi)\in\widetilde M(D)$ with $c'_n(\psi)|_{D(f)}=y/f^n\in M_f$ for every $f\in I$ and every $y\in M$ whose class in $M/M_n$ is $\psi(f^n)$ (the fraction $y/f^n$ does not depend on the choice of $y$, as $f^nM_n=0$); one has $c'_{n+1}(\bar p_n\circ\psi|_{I^{n+1}})=c'_n(\psi)$, where $\bar p_n:M/M_n\to M/M_{n+1}$ is the projection, and the induced map $\varinjlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_A(I^n,M/M_n)\to\widetilde M(D)$ (transition maps $\psi\mapsto\bar p_n\circ\psi|_{I^{n+1}}$) is bijective. (3) If for $x\in M$, $Ix=0$ implies $x=0$, then $M_n=0$ for all $n$ and the map of (1) is bijective.
